lyrics: Got my helmet and my flak   jacket on
Another day waiting for another   false dawn
See the world through a six-inch pane   of glass
Watching history as it rolls on past
Waiting for the colonel on the forward base
To give the official story a time   and a place
My questions are loaded, my   notebook is clean
Just here to report on the   sanitized scene
I’m embedded in the gear, embedded in the fear
Show you what they let me, make it crystal clear
I’m a voluntary captive, a guest of the state
Just another filter on the televised hate
Saw a little girl’s shoe by a   blasted-out wall
Heard a sound like crying down a ruined hall
But the C.O. just tells me that’s off   the record now
And you learn not to ask any questions how
So I film the soldiers giving candy to a kid
And I write down the talking points, just like they bid
And I send it back home on a satellite feed
Planting the brave and heroic seed
I’m embedded in the gear, embedded in the fear
Show you what they let me, make it crystal clear
I’m a voluntary captive, a guest of the state
Just another filter on the televised hate
I traded my questions for a front-row seat
To the greatest damn story on the whole damn street But the words
all taste like ash, they all feel like a crime I'm just a
part of the machine, keeping perfect
time Keeping perfect time...
